purpose: Renderer/backend contract. The barcode identifies; sources verify. No inheritance or absence-to-negative inference.

payload.overall_status: one of allowed_statuses, optional; supplied by backend only

records.title: string
records.summary: string; factual explanation of what the source supports
records.date: ISO date or source date, required for verified statuses unless source date supplied

source.name: string, required for verified statuses
source.url: https URL, optional but strongly recommended

hard_rules: NOT_VERIFIED means only: No verificado en las fuentes consultadas.
Never infer not certified, not halal, not cruelty-free or tested from absence.
Never inherit brand to SKU, parent to brand, brand to parent, plant to SKU, product to company, or market A to market B.
VERIFIED_SCOPE must render the exact scope and must not be displayed as VERIFIED_PRODUCT.
REGULATORY_CONTEXT proves registry/context only, not halal or animal-testing status unless the source explicitly supports that.
SELF_DECLARED must remain visibly distinct from independent verification.
A verified record must have subject, scope, source and date/retrieval date. If missing, the renderer does not display it as verified.
